title: Pontiac Fiero GT 1987
author: loadversus
acquisition: Official Sketchfab Download 3D Model modal, authenticated existing user account, glTF source download. Modal confirmed free and commercial use allowed.
conversion: Original glTF, binary geometry and all ten original texture images packed into one GLB by scripts/pack-fiero-source.mjs. No decimation, image alteration, geometry modification or material replacement.
runtimeModifications: Y rotation by pi to match driving-local forward -Z; uniform scale 0.77 and centering/ground alignment.
Original native cabin and steering geometry retained; existing Buena Onda PhysicalRadio fitted into native center dashboard above original stereo location to clear gear lever.
Native Stekla window meshes hidden only in first-person cockpit mode; glazing retained in chase mode.
Existing cruise light controls drive independent headlights and small cabin illumination.
interiorVisualQuality: Native cabin and interactive head unit visually reviewed in actual Cruise at 1280x720 and 390x844; source gauges remain static textures. This is not a photorealism certification.
credit: Pontiac Fiero GT 1987 by loadversus, via Sketchfab, licensed CC BY 4.0. Modified for Buena Onda Cruise: format packing, driving-space normalization, cockpit glazing visibility and interactive radio integration.
